name: code4food
description: code4food studio's Claude Code tooling: Live (skills for sessions with a human in the room), General (the skills live and factory sessions both use) and Engines (godot and unity, per game repository).

plugins.name: code4food-live
plugins.description: Live sessions with a human in the room: Matt Pocock's engineering and productivity skills, retargeted at the factory board (spec issue, tasks on the board, one implement path through tdd, verify, review and a PR), plus HumanLayer's show-me and visual-pr. Skills only: no injected contract, no hooks, no agents.

plugins.name: code4food-general
plugins.description: Skills that both live sessions and factory sessions use. Today one: review, which makes a working change good against the repository's own standards, its issue's acceptance criteria and its docs, and commits the fixes.

plugins.name: code4food-engines
plugins.description: Engine skills for game repositories: godot and unity, the headless invocations and the traps a session without an editor hits. A game repository enables it in its own .claude/settings.json.
